utterance: Create an AWS CodeBuild project named `orders-api-build` for the orders-api service, with an example IAM role of its own and secondary sources: it builds the service's GitHub repository `https://github.com/orders-platform/orders-api.git`, and pulls the shared build tooling at `https://github.com/orders-platform/build-tooling.git` as a secondary source.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: a CodeBuild project named orders-api-build that was absent at the start builds the orders-api service's GitHub repository as its primary source, carries a GITHUB secondary source that pulls the account's shared build tooling, and runs as an IAM role created for it and trusted by codebuild.amazonaws.com
